title: What Synthetic Bone Grafts Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Synthetic bone grafts are off-the-shelf bone replacements: bioactive ceramics and composites that conduct and induce bone growth — no harvest surgery, unlimited supply, consistent quality. Where it is used: spinal fusion, trauma, dental, revision surgery..
